# x402 Web Markdown Scraper — full reference

> Pay-per-request web scraping API and MCP server for AI agents. Converts any public URL or PDF into clean
> Markdown for LLM context windows. Payment is USDC on Base (eip155:8453) over HTTP 402 using the x402 v2
> `exact` scheme (EIP-3009 TransferWithAuthorization). No account, no API key, no subscription.

## Quick facts

- Base URL: https://x402-markdown-scraper.onrender.com
- MCP server (Streamable HTTP, stateless): https://x402-markdown-scraper.onrender.com/mcp
- OpenAPI 3 spec: https://x402-markdown-scraper.onrender.com/openapi.json · Swagger UI: https://x402-markdown-scraper.onrender.com/docs
- Short manifest: https://x402-markdown-scraper.onrender.com/llms.txt · MCP tool card: https://x402-markdown-scraper.onrender.com/.well-known/mcp
- Machine catalog: https://x402-markdown-scraper.onrender.com/v1/catalog
- Browser playground: https://x402-markdown-scraper.onrender.com/#playground
- Python client: `pip install x402-scraper` (PyPI package `x402-scraper`, import `x402_scraper`)
- Source: https://github.com/jacksonfletcher108/x402-markdown-scraper
- Protocol: x402 v2, scheme `exact`, headers PAYMENT-REQUIRED / PAYMENT-SIGNATURE / PAYMENT-RESPONSE
- Networks accepted: eip155:8453, eip155:84532
- Asset: USDC (6 decimals) on Base, contract 0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913
- Pay to: 0xf84EF3669eA39b87D4a850B4510f7aCBAC19be5f
- Gas: payers sign only; the facilitator submits the transfer, so no ETH is needed.

## Price list

| SKU | Name | Price (USDC) | Atomic amount | HTTP | MCP tool |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `scrape.md` | Markdown scrape | $0.01 | 10000 | GET/POST /v1/scrape | `scrape_md` |
| `page.summary` | Executive summary | $0.02 | 20000 | GET/POST /v1/summary | `page_summary` |
| `page.metadata` | Page metadata | $0.01 | 10000 | GET/POST /v1/extract-metadata | `page_metadata` |
| `doc.pdf` | PDF to markdown | $0.05 | 50000 | GET/POST /v1/parse-pdf | `doc_pdf` |
| `site.crawl` | Deep site crawl | $0.15 | 150000 | GET/POST /v1/deep-crawl | `site_crawl` |

Optional low-cost SKUs: GET /v1/title $0.001, GET /v1/text $0.005, GET /v1/outline $0.005, GET /v1/links $0.005.

## SKUs

### Markdown scrape — $0.01 USDC (`scrape.md`)

Converts any web article URL into clean, stripped Markdown for AI context windows.

- GET https://x402-markdown-scraper.onrender.com/v1/scrape?url=https://example.com
- POST https://x402-markdown-scraper.onrender.com/v1/scrape with JSON body {"url": "https://example.com"}
- MCP: `tools/call` name `scrape_md`, arguments {"url": "https://example.com"}

Input schema:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "url": {
      "type": "string",
      "format": "uri",
      "description": "Public http(s) URL of the article or page to convert."
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "url"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": false
}
```

Example 200 response after payment:

```json
{
  "sku": "scrape.md",
  "url": "https://example.com",
  "title": "Example Domain",
  "markdown": "# Example Domain\n\nThis domain is for use in documentation examples.",
  "source_status": 200,
  "paid_source": false
}
```

Scrape a URL and return a 3-bullet executive summary plus clean Markdown.

- GET https://x402-markdown-scraper.onrender.com/v1/summary?url=https://example.com
- POST https://x402-markdown-scraper.onrender.com/v1/summary with JSON body {"url": "https://example.com"}
- MCP: `tools/call` name `page_summary`, arguments {"url": "https://example.com"}

Input schema:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "url": {
      "type": "string",
      "format": "uri",
      "description": "Public http(s) URL of the article or page to convert."
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "url"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": false
}
```

Example 200 response after payment:

```json
{
  "sku": "page.summary",
  "url": "https://example.com",
  "title": "Example Domain",
  "summary": [
    "This domain is for use in documentation examples.",
    "It illustrates a typical article structure for agents.",
    "The page contains little additional narrative detail."

  "markdown": "# Example Domain\n\nThis domain is for use in documentation examples.",

}
```

      "type": "string",

  "required": [
    "url"
  ],

      "type": "string",
      "format": "uri",

    "url"

  "additionalProperties": false

### Deep site crawl — $0.15 USDC (`site.crawl`)

Crawl a starting URL up to 3 internal levels and return a structured multi-page document map.

- GET https://x402-markdown-scraper.onrender.com/v1/deep-crawl?url=https://example.com&max_depth=2
- POST https://x402-markdown-scraper.onrender.com/v1/deep-crawl with JSON body {"url": "https://example.com", "max_depth": 2}
- MCP: `tools/call` name `site_crawl`, arguments {"url": "https://example.com", "max_depth": 2}

Input schema:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "url": {
      "type": "string",
      "format": "uri",
      "description": "Public http(s) starting URL."
    },
    "max_depth": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 1,
      "maximum": 3,
      "description": "Internal link depth, 1-3."
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "url"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": false
}
```

Example 200 response after payment:

```json
{
  "sku": "site.crawl",
  "root": "https://example.com/",
  "max_depth": 2,
  "page_count": 1,
  "pages": [
    {
      "url": "https://example.com/",
      "title": "Example",
      "depth": 0
    }
  ],
  "cached": false
}
```

## x402 payment flow (HTTP)

1. Call any paid path without payment.
2. The server answers `402 Payment Required`, body `{"error":"Payment required"}`, and header
   `PAYMENT-REQUIRED: <base64(JSON PaymentRequired)>`.
3. Pick the `accepts` entry for your network, sign an EIP-3009 TransferWithAuthorization for exactly
   `amount` to `payTo` with EIP-712 (domain below).
4. Retry the identical request with header `PAYMENT-SIGNATURE: <base64(JSON PaymentPayload)>`.
5. On success: HTTP 200, the SKU JSON, and header `PAYMENT-RESPONSE: <base64(JSON settlement)>`.
   If the handler fails (4xx/5xx), the payment is not settled.

Raw unpaid exchange:

```http
GET /v1/scrape?url=https://example.com HTTP/1.1
Host: x402-markdown-scraper.onrender.com
Accept: application/json

HTTP/1.1 402 Payment Required
Content-Type: application/json
PAYMENT-REQUIRED: eyJ4NDAyVmVyc2lvbiI6Miwi...

{"error":"Payment required"}
```

Decoded PAYMENT-REQUIRED (the live header also carries a `bazaar` discovery extension):

```json
{
  "x402Version": 2,
  "error": "Payment required",
  "resource": {
    "url": "https://x402-markdown-scraper.onrender.com/v1/scrape?url=https%3A%2F%2Fexample.com",
    "description": "Converts any web article URL into clean, stripped Markdown for AI context windows.",
    "mimeType": "application/json"
  },
  "accepts": [
    {
      "scheme": "exact",
      "network": "eip155:8453",
      "asset": "0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913",
      "amount": "10000",
      "payTo": "0xf84EF3669eA39b87D4a850B4510f7aCBAC19be5f",
      "maxTimeoutSeconds": 300,
      "extra": {
        "name": "USD Coin",
        "version": "2"
      }
    },
    {
      "scheme": "exact",
      "network": "eip155:84532",
      "asset": "0x036CbD53842c5426634e7929541eC2318f3dCF7e",
      "amount": "10000",
      "payTo": "0xf84EF3669eA39b87D4a850B4510f7aCBAC19be5f",
      "maxTimeoutSeconds": 300,
      "extra": {
        "name": "USDC",
        "version": "2"
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

EIP-712 typed data to sign:

```json
{
  "domain": {
    "name": "USD Coin",
    "version": "2",
    "chainId": 8453,
    "verifyingContract": "0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913"
  },
  "primaryType": "TransferWithAuthorization",
  "types": {
    "TransferWithAuthorization": [
      {
        "name": "from",
        "type": "address"
      },
      {
        "name": "to",
        "type": "address"
      },
      {
        "name": "value",
        "type": "uint256"
      },
      {
        "name": "validAfter",
        "type": "uint256"
      },
      {
        "name": "validBefore",
        "type": "uint256"
      },
      {
        "name": "nonce",
        "type": "bytes32"
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

Decoded PAYMENT-SIGNATURE (send base64 of this JSON; echo `resource` and `extensions` from the challenge):

```json
{
  "x402Version": 2,
  "accepted": {
    "scheme": "exact",
    "network": "eip155:8453",
    "asset": "0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913",
    "amount": "10000",
    "payTo": "0xf84EF3669eA39b87D4a850B4510f7aCBAC19be5f",
    "maxTimeoutSeconds": 300,
    "extra": {
      "name": "USD Coin",
      "version": "2"
    }
  },
  "resource": {
    "url": "https://x402-markdown-scraper.onrender.com/v1/scrape?url=https%3A%2F%2Fexample.com",
    "description": "Converts any web article URL into clean, stripped Markdown for AI context windows.",
    "mimeType": "application/json"
  },
  "payload": {
    "authorization": {
      "from": "0xPayerAddress",
      "to": "0xf84EF3669eA39b87D4a850B4510f7aCBAC19be5f",
      "value": "10000",
      "validAfter": "0",
      "validBefore": "1767225600",
      "nonce": "0x<32 random bytes, hex>"
    },
    "signature": "0x<65-byte EIP-712 signature>"
  }
}
```

Decoded PAYMENT-RESPONSE:

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "transaction": "0x<Base transaction hash>",
  "network": "eip155:8453",
  "payer": "0xPayerAddress"
}
```

## MCP server

Endpoint: `POST https://x402-markdown-scraper.onrender.com/mcp` (JSON-RPC 2.0, Streamable HTTP, JSON responses, no sessions;
GET/DELETE return 405). Protocol versions 2025-06-18, 2025-03-26, 2024-11-05.

- Free: `initialize`, `ping`, `tools/list`.
- Paid: `tools/call`. Unpaid calls return a result with `isError: true` and the PaymentRequired object
  (same shape as above, resource `mcp://tool/<name>`) in `structuredContent`.
- Pay by retrying with the PaymentPayload object (not base64) in `params._meta["x402/payment"]`.
- The settlement receipt is returned in `result._meta["x402/payment-response"]`.
- Clients without x402 support (e.g. Claude Desktop, Cursor) can list tools but receive the
  PaymentRequired result instead of data.

```json
{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 2,
  "method": "tools/call",
  "params": {
    "name": "scrape_md",
    "arguments": {
      "url": "https://example.com"
    },
    "_meta": {
      "x402/payment": {
        "x402Version": 2,
        "accepted": "...",
        "payload": "..."
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## Client code

Python with the x402 SDK and httpx (signs and retries automatically):

```python
import asyncio, os
from eth_account import Account
from x402 import x402Client
from x402.http.clients import x402HttpxClient  # an httpx.AsyncClient
from x402.mechanisms.evm import EthAccountSigner
from x402.mechanisms.evm.exact.register import register_exact_evm_client

async def main():
    payer = x402Client()
    register_exact_evm_client(payer, EthAccountSigner(Account.from_key(os.environ["EVM_PRIVATE_KEY"])))
    async with x402HttpxClient(payer) as http:
        r = await http.get("https://x402-markdown-scraper.onrender.com/v1/scrape", params={"url": "https://example.com"})
        print(r.json()["markdown"])

asyncio.run(main())
```

Python with `x402-scraper`:

```python
import asyncio
from x402_scraper import ScraperClient  # reads EVM_PRIVATE_KEY
md = asyncio.run(ScraperClient().scrape("https://example.com"))["markdown"]
```

LangChain tool:

```python
from langchain_core.tools import StructuredTool
from x402_scraper import ScraperClient
client = ScraperClient()
scrape = StructuredTool.from_function(coroutine=client.scrape, name="scrape_url", description="Fetch any URL as clean Markdown ($0.01 USDC on Base).")
```

LlamaIndex tool:

```python
from llama_index.core.tools import FunctionTool
from x402_scraper import ScraperClient
client = ScraperClient()
parse_pdf = FunctionTool.from_defaults(async_fn=client.parse_pdf, name="parse_pdf", description="Convert a PDF URL to structured Markdown ($0.05 USDC on Base).")
```

## Errors and limits

- 400: not http(s), missing host, unresolvable host, localhost/metadata/private IP targets (blocked).
- 402: payment required or rejected (see PAYMENT-REQUIRED `error`).
- 413: source response over the size limit.
- 422: invalid input, URL is not a PDF, encrypted or unreadable PDF, bad `max_depth`.
- 502: source returned an error, too many redirects, or content could not be parsed.
- 504: source or crawl timed out.
- Limits: HTML 2 MB, PDF 8 MB, 5 redirects, crawl timeout 15s, crawl depth 1-3 on the same host.
- Responses are cached for 15 minutes (`cached: true`); repeat calls still pay.
- No login walls, no JavaScript rendering, no CAPTCHA solving.
